messages:
alex_fin: FYI — Nimbus Supplies invoice INV-2026-114 arrived with no PO. Amount $14,320. Vendor claims PO PO-9812 but AP portal shows none. Attachment: invoice_114.pdf
sam_procure: Can you drop the attachment? I'll check our PO system. If vendor had PO it should show in ProcureOne.
invoice_bot: New invoice INV-2026-114 uploaded by Nimbus Supplies. Amount: $14,320. PO: none detected. Attachment: https://files.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-114.pdf
sam_procure: Opening ProcureOne -> searched for PO-9812 and nothing. Maybe vendor used an old PO series. @jordan_ops do you know if PO-9812 exists under a different cost center?
jordan_ops: Not in my list. We had PO-9812 issued in 2024 to a different vendor (looks like typo). The approver assigned is @taylor_manager for cost center 6003 but the invoice is coded to 6200.
maria_finance: Coding mismatch — invoice GL 6200 vs expected 6003. If we change cost center we need manager approval. Can procurement confirm which cost center vendor should bill to?
sam_procure: Reaching out to vendor (Nimbus) now, asking for copy of PO from their side and the original PO number they used. Will paste vendor reply here.
vendor_nimbus: (via email) Hi Redwood team — we reference PO-9812 on our stub. Attaching our PO copy (PO_Nimbus_9812.pdf). Please confirm match.
sam_procure: Received PO copy; vendor PO shows company name "Nimbus Supplies LLC" and PO-9812 but our PO registry shows PO-9812 assigned to "Nimbus Solutions" (different vendor ID). Looks like vendor name variance caused mislinking. I'll create an internal match request and set approver to @taylor_manager. ETA 2 hours.
alex_fin: If you change approver, can we flag invoice for expedited routing? This vendor has a critical SLA on our infra parts.
jordan_ops: I'll pre-approve routing override for this invoice to avoid stale payments, but finance needs final sign-off once cost center fixed.
maria_finance: OK — I changed GL to 6003 as provisional and set notes: "pending vendor PO verification". Please keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
sam_procure: Created manual PO-match request in ProcureOne: request id RQ-2026-778. Action items: vendor to confirm legal entity + attach remittance; @taylor_manager to approve RQ; @maria_finance to confirm GL post-approval.
alex_fin: Thanks. Tag me when it's approved so I can release hold in AP system.
invoice_bot: Invoice INV-2026-114 status updated: HOLD -> MANUAL_MATCH_REQUEST (RQ-2026-778).
taylor_manager: I'll review RQ-2026-778 now. If vendor docs match, I'll approve and set approver routing to cost center 6003.
sam_procure: Vendor also asked for expedited payment option; I told them we'll process after routing is fixed. Will update in 2h.
alex_fin: Great — closing for now. Keep thread alive with any doc changes.
